bl_note: In the finite encoded universe every relation is a decidable table, and a decidable relation is located (Lean: located_of_decidable), so Bl coincides extensionally with A here.  The Prop-level gap between A and locatedness is metatheoretic; the matrix cells from A-implying sources into Bl are therefore declared OPEN_LOCATED (EXPECTED_OPEN) instead of being closed by the finite search, which by construction finds no countermodel for them.

bounds.designated_points: all ordered pairs (a, b) in X x X
bounds.ops_note: at n = 1 the identity and const_0 tables coincide; enumeration items are counted without deduplication
bounds.relations: all subsets of X x X, enumerated exhaustively
bounds.witness_key: (n, len(r), len(ret)+len(prot), len(ops), sorted(r), a, b); ties broken by (sorted(ret), sorted(prot), sorted(ops))

presentation_branching.coarseness: q1 <= q2 iff ker(q1) subset-of ker(q2); a larger kernel identifies more, so maximal = coarsest faithful
presentation_branching.note: Of the three two-block partitions of the carrier, {0,1}|{2} merges the designated edge and is unfaithful; the two faithful coarsest kernel classes are incomparable, so no faithful presentation is coarser-or-equal to all others (finite mirror of the no-weakly-terminal finding).
